deck_context.core_claim: ETRI analyzed NPU execution conditions and low-level paths, implemented custom-stage replacement and actual KV-transfer NPU PD runtimes, and developed lmd-top for model operations. These are separate research implementations, not one finished automatic controller.
deck_context.narrative: 1 whole map → 2 conditions problem → 3 low-level entry points → 4 custom code integration → 5 stage separation → 6 operations → 7 collaboration return to map.
deck_context.facts: Hardware/vendor compiler/Kubernetes/Prometheus are reused infrastructure, not ETRI inventions. PD is a split execution method, not IR. Do not claim GPU-NPU PD completed: completed PD records are RNGD/ATOM. No benchmark numbers. May not claim all custom kernels verified. lmd-top manages vendor compile Jobs, not compiler itself.

slides.intent: Zoom into model preparation: show why resource management must include compile settings.
slides.layout: One large model icon on left branches into only THREE artifact sheets in middle with distinct simple shape/config symbols, then converges toward a modest NPU outline right. Label model '모델', artifact group '조건별 아티팩트', destination 'NPU 실행'. Below main diagram two concise result dimensions '실행 성능' and '컴파일 시간·파일 크기'. Tiny breadcrumb '전체 환경 → 실행 조건'. Do not turn into three equal text cards.
slides.local_context: We compared bucket/parallel settings and compile time/artifact size. No claim all GPUs dynamic or all NPUs static. This is used NPU path.
constraints: Exact Korean title and listed text; no invented charts or numbers; match sample palette but use a branching flow composition.

slides.title: 모델이 NPU에서 실행되는 과정을 분석했습니다
slides.intent: From settings problem, descend into the interfaces where we can intervene.
slides.layout: Create a full 16:9 Korean technical slide. Match attached approved slide1 ETRI blue/white style, large navy title and ETRI upper right; no page numbers. Title: 모델이 NPU에서 실행되는 과정을 분석했습니다. Simple left-to-right three-step illustrated story with large icons: '모델' (neural network icon) → '실행 준비' (compiler/file icon) → 'NPU 실행' (chip icon). Under stages respectively: '어떤 연산으로 구성되나?', '장비가 실행할 형태로 변환', '연산과 데이터 이동'. Highlight a pale-blue bracket spanning execution preparation and NPU execution labeled '우리가 분석한 범위'. Below it two short readable explanations: '저수준 IR: 연산·메모리 동작을 표현한 중간 단계' and '무엇을 계산하고, 데이터를 어디로 옮기는지 확인'. Closing small callout '실행 시간에 영향을 주는 지점과 변경 가능한 부분 파악'. No Rust, DSL, HBM, DM, DMA, API names, code or benchmark numbers. This is analysis of vendor-provided compiler/runtime, not own compiler development. Lots of whitespace, clearly readable Korean. One main flow, no dense cards.
slides.local_context: Provided custom-kernel guide describes Python DSL, Rust LIR, module compile and artifact paths. ETRI analyzed entry points, data movement, and mappings; did not author vendor whole compiler.

slides.title: 실행의 일부를 바꿔볼 수 있는 기반을 만들었습니다
slides.intent: Explain concrete ETRI implementation L8Swapper, not generic custom kernel possibility.
slides.layout: Create one full 16:9 Korean technical slide matching attached approved slide1 ETRI blue/white style, navy large title, ETRI upper right, no page numbers. Title: 실행의 일부를 바꿔볼 수 있는 기반을 만들었습니다. One large conceptual illustration: a gray outlined container labeled '기존 NPU 실행 엔진', inside a left-to-right three-block flow '기존 실행' → bright blue '직접 작성한 코드' → '기존 실행'. Above the blue block a small code-file icon with an arrow entering it labeled '우리가 개발한 연결 도구'. This shows local replacement within retained vendor engine, not engine rewrite. Below only two short plain-language statements: '엔진 전체를 바꾸지 않고 필요한 부분만 수정' and '수정한 코드가 실제 호출되는 경로 확인'. Bottom small connection to next slide: '실행 일부 변경 → 실행 단계를 다른 NPU로 분리'. Do not use L8Swapper, stage, binary, artifact, dispatch, input/output specs, Rust or any API names. No before-after duplicate flow, no 5-stage workflow, no benchmarks. Do not imply fully implemented attention or measured acceleration. Large icons, clear hierarchy, generous whitespace.
slides.local_context: L8Swapper is ETRI tool to compile/replace stage binary in vendor artifact and validate dispatch. Rust verification includes passthrough dispatch, not full attention replacement correctness. No code or implementation API list.

slides.title: 실제 KV를 넘겨 NPU 사이에서 실행을 나눴습니다
slides.intent: Extend from replacing a stage to placing execution phases on different NPUs.
slides.layout: One spacious three-part horizontal diagram. Left distinct blue processor+input tokens, center KV memory buffer with transfer arrows, right processor+output token sequence. Labels beneath left/right 'NPU A' / 'NPU B'. Blue connector caption '직접 구현한 KV 전송 경로'. Bottom modest text 'Furiosa ↔ Rebellions' and '동종·이종 조합 / 역할 교환'. A restrained small callout 'KV 유지·연산 배치·컴파일 조건도 분석'. Tiny breadcrumb '커스텀 실행 → 단계 분리'.
slides.local_context: Actual RNGD/ATOM KV handoff implemented via own runtime; shm serving and separate TCP tests. Not GPU→NPU completion, not a claim generic network remote server placement. lmd-top is not this runtime/controller. Initial re-prefill emulation not current illustrated work.
constraints: No performance gain number or always-faster claim. Large diagram and readable concise Korean labels.
